title: Hospital Tools And Medicines
description: This project adds a decorational / RP items like medicines and doctor / nurse items, this mod is family-friendly, not something bad, don't worry
body:
**Hospital Tools And Medicines**
**EVERYONE LISTEN! THIS MOD IS FAMILY-FRIENDLY, THERE ARE NOT BAD THINGS, DON'T WORRY, ITS JUST A DECORATIONAL MOD FOR RP**

This mod is mean't to add medical non-fuctional rp items and non-functional family-friendly doctor items.

**NOTE: This mod is for Roleplaying in hospital, do not use it for something else.**


<details>
<summary>This mod will add - Spoiler</summary>

This mod will add:
- A big line of medicines
- some doctor / nurse tools
- 2 creative tab categories, "Medicines" and "Tools"

</details>



**NOTE 2: This mod wil do not get so many updates, beacuse we are lazy studios, so we are lazy to update it, pray if we update it (in the good way).**

Thanks for not reporting! And see ya in the hospital!
ENJOY!

Lazy Studios 2026
